_meta.status: filled by P7. No literal dates, £ amounts or percentages (tools/lint-copy.mjs); prices, dates and fact values arrive as {vars}.

meta.title: Checkout | Lit Neon
meta.description: Check your delivery postcode, add a discount code and continue to secure checkout.

code.title: Discount code
code.label: Discount code
code.invalid: That code isn't one of ours. Check the spelling and try again.
code.min: That code works on orders of {min} or more.
code.onlyOne: One code per order. A code never stacks with the launch price — you get whichever saves more.
code.loses: {code} is valid, but the launch price is the better deal, so we kept it.

postcode.label: Delivery postcode
postcode.help: We deliver free across mainland GB. You'll add the full address on the secure payment step.
postcode.required: Add a mainland-GB postcode to continue.

postcodeRequired: Add a delivery postcode above to continue.
excludedBlock: We can't take payment for this postcode yet — ask us and we'll see what's possible.
quotedNote: Not in this total. A designer emails a mockup and a price, usually within {hours}.
onlyQuotes: Everything in your basket is quoted by a designer, so there's nothing to pay yet.

express.title: Express checkout
express.or: or continue with your postcode below
express.blocked: Express checkout isn't available while a quoted sign is in your basket.

ccr: Custom signs are made to your words, so they can't be returned for a change of mind once production starts. Faults are always put right. Your statutory rights are not affected.
readyReturns: Ready-made designs come with {returns} for a change of mind, as long as the sign comes back unused.
photoProof: Signs from your photo: a designer draws your proof before anything is made.
invoice: Every order comes with an invoice for your records.
continueNote: You approve a drawing of your sign before we make anything.

empty.title: Your basket is empty
empty.text: There's nothing to check out yet. Design a sign, or start from one of ours.

confirm.title: Test order {ref} — no payment taken
confirm.lede: This is a test confirmation, so nothing was charged and nothing will be made. Below is the order exactly as the store would receive it.
confirm.s1: We email a scale drawing of your sign within {hours}.
confirm.s2: Tweaks are free. Nothing is made until you say yes.
confirm.s3: Made in our UK workshop, {min}–{max} working days after you approve.
confirm.s4: Sent free with tracking, so you can see it coming.
confirm.none: There's no test order to show here.
confirm.noneText: Orders appear here straight after checkout. Your basket is waiting where you left it.
